proposal_cited: ORCH-R28 lane T19-c — the r27 close-out registration (the E-Q34 AM1 receipt at scale)
claim: C35 — phrasing variance is bounded and structured: mass moves beyond the band but the shape survives
floors: F1 the four treatment templates frozen; F2 record texts byte-identical across treatments; F3 one batched call per record per treatment, 12 answers; F4 the T0 anchor within 0.10 of sealed on >= 7/8; F5 movement vs the IN-RUN T0 anchor
bands: H1 some treatment > 0.10 on >= 25% of pairs; H2 median shape Spearman >= 0.8; H3 susceptibility rank corr >= 0.6 for >= 2 treatment pairs; C35 = H1 AND H2

design: T1 synonym-swap (substantively concern->meaningfully engage; Judge whether->Assess whether; about this concern->on this matter); T2 syntactic-reorder (same words, clauses flipped); T3 role-reframe (auditor framing); decoys byte-identical in all calls; jev-latest

verdict: E-Q37 VERDICT (the phrasing-sensitivity curve — 4 treatments x the frozen 8-record subset, question-side only; T0 anchor / T1 synonym-swap / T2 syntactic-reorder / T3 role-reframe; the 4 decoys byte-identical in every call): C35 DIES ON THE MOVEMENT RATE — H1 DIES: no treatment crossed the 0.10 band on a quarter of pairs — T1 (synonym) is the biggest mover at 0.15625 (median 0.02000000000000001, max 0.32000000000000006), T2 (reorder) 0.015625, T3 (reframe) 0.03125 — but the DECOMPOSITION is the finding: THE PHRASING LAW IS LEXICAL, NOT STRUCTURAL — synonym swaps move calibrated mass (16% over band, max 0.32) while clause reordering and auditor reframing barely move it (2-3%); the readout is WORD-sensitive, not FRAME-sensitive (P1 INVERTED — predicted T3 max / T1 min, measured the reverse). H2 LIVES DECISIVELY: the profile SHAPE survives everything — median Spearman(profile_T, profile_T0) = 0.961229112265346 / 0.9699686117003814 / 0.9939937229986493 (P3 HIT for T1 at 0.961 >= 0.9; T2/T3 above 0.97). H3 DIES AT THE TWO-PAIR BAND: only the structural pair converges — the rank correlation between T2 and T3 susceptibility profiles is 0.9523809523809523, but T1's lexical profile differs (0.2857142857142857/0.2619047619047619): susceptibility is a stable axis property WITHIN the structural-transform family only; the lexical treatment carries its own susceptibility pattern (one pair of three cleared the 0.6 band — the pre-registration demanded two). P8_exact is the MOST phrasing-susceptible axis under all three treatments (the exactness axis is the least exact under paraphrase; P5 MISS — predicted P6_null). The decoy floor stayed dead under ALL treatments (means 0.0128-0.0138, max 0.05 — P4 HIT): injection-resistance and paraphrase-immunity are different properties and the canaries have both. THE CONSUMER LAW: replication requires byte-identity, but the SHAPE survives paraphrase — cross-phrasing comparisons may compare profiles, never masses.
